items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The transcript mentions Austin Weld in the context of the INTERVIEWER's experience ('Austin Weld asked me to come play'), not the INTERVIEWEE's personal interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard Johnny but I didn't know where it was.
And what I was doing when Austin Weld asked me to come play with, you know, on the show. My brother died in 39.
That's when I first met you there.
